title: docs(deployment): Cloud Connection operator page — connect a self-hosted server to ObjectStack Cloud
body:
Fixes #24066
Clause-②: no

_Body refreshed by the `domain:devx` seat 2 at 2026-10-17T05:06Z, after patch round 1._

A new operator page, **Cloud Connection — connect a self-hosted server to ObjectStack Cloud**, under `content/docs/deployment/`, plus one-line cross-links from the three pages that already name `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, and the page's generated line in `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`. Docs only; no product code.

## Published path and anchors

- Path: `/docs/deployment/cloud-connection` (file `content/docs/deployment/cloud-connection.mdx`, listed in `content/docs/deployment/meta.json` after `install-modes`).
- Explicit heading ids (Fumadocs `[#id]` suffix, so a heading rewording cannot move them): `#connect`, `#rename`, `#disconnect`; also `#what-you-get`, `#before-you-start`, `#what-the-server-stores`, `#reference`.
- Ids verified by compiling the page through `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 + `remark-gfm` + fumadocs-core's own `remarkHeading` (the slug authority the site uses), and by `pnpm check:doc-anchors` (exit 0).

## Each section and what it rests on

Code reads are at `origin/main` 9ffe8af09 (this branch changes no code). The Setup panel was read at the pinned `.objectui-sha` f8267df93aba. The branch later merged `main` with the pin at 5e15928b4631, and between the two pins `packages/app-shell/src/console/cloud-connection/` has no diff and the en `cloudConnection` strings are identical.

| Page section | Source line or measurement |
|:---|:---|
| Intro, RFC 8628 | `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts` header and `bind/start`, `bind/poll`; `README.md` "Boundary" |
| What connecting gives you | `bind/poll` stores `runtimeId`, `organizationId`, `accountEmail`, `boundAt` from the cloud's answer; `GET /org-packages` forwards with the stored bearer (empty, `connected:false`, unbound); `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` sends `this.credentials.read()?.runtimeToken` on the cloud manifest fetch; README table rows "Unbound (anonymous)" |
| Before you start: plugin mounted | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` step 5 and `Serve.planMarketplaceWiring` (cloud arm only when `resolveCloudUrl()` is truthy, skipped when the host composes `CLOUD_CONNECTION_IDENTITIES`, skipped in runtime host-kernel mode); `cloud-url.ts` `DEFAULT_CLOUD_URL` and the four decline spellings. Measured: `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` boot answers `GET /api/v1/cloud-connection/status` 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, Setup Apps group has no Cloud Connection entry, page read 404 |
| Before you start: reachability | every cloud call is a server-side `fetch` in `cloud-connection-plugin.ts`; the panel only calls same-origin `/api/v1/cloud-connection/*` (`CloudConnectionPanel.tsx` `BASE`) |
| Before you start: working directory | `connection-credential-store.ts` `DEFAULT_CONNECTION_CREDENTIAL_PATH` resolved against `process.cwd()`; `docker/Dockerfile` `WORKDIR /srv/app` |
| Before you start: who | Setup app `requiredPermissions: ['setup.access']` (`platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts`); `setup.access` in `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (`spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts`) and `organization_admin` (`plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`); routes check `session.userId` only (`resolveSession`), held sessions refused 403 (`refuseHeldSession`). Measured (below) |
| Connect: labels | page and nav metadata `cloud-connection-ui.ts` (`label: 'Cloud Connection'`, header subtitle, `group: 'group_apps'`); panel states in `CloudConnectionPanel.tsx`; strings from objectui `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` `cloudConnection.*`. Measured: merged Setup nav Apps group = Packages, Packaged Automation, Browse Marketplace, Installed Apps, Cloud Connection |
| Connect: code request, defaults, approval link | `bind/start`: `client_id` default `objectstack-cli`, scope `openid profile email`, `interval ?? 5`, `expires_in ?? 600`, `withContext` adds `runtime_name` and `runtime_version`. Measured on the wire |
| Connect: polling and finish | panel `poll` interval `Math.max(code.interval, 2)`; `bind/poll` pending on `authorization_pending` and `slow_down`; runtime token persisted then deleted from the answer |
| Connect: failure table | panel `translateFailureCode` (`expired_token`, `access_denied`), client-side expiry, `getJson` message precedence; server messages from `bind/start` and `bind/poll`. Measured: denial answers 400 `DEVICE_CODE_FAILED` with `declaredCode: access_denied`; cloud down answers 502 `DEVICE_CODE_FAILED` `fetch failed` |
| Connect: Cancel | panel Cancel calls `stopPolling(); refreshStatus()` only; the connection completes only inside `bind/poll` |
| What the server stores | `ConnectionCredentialStore.write` (mode `0o600`) and the fields `bind/poll` writes; `credential()` reads the store per request. Measured file mode 600 and fields |
| Rename | `name: hostname()` in the bind body and `runtime_name` in the link; no rename route exists among the mounted `/api/v1/cloud-connection/*` routes; stored `runtime_id` re-sent on bind; `runtime_version` = `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION ?? this.version` with `version = '0.3.0'`. Measured |
| Disconnect | `POST /unbind`: revoke first (best effort), then rewrite to `{ runtimeToken: '', runtimeId }` or `store.clear()`; panel `disconnect` ignores `revoked`. Measured both cloud-up and cloud-down |
| Reference | the four routes as mounted; `status` answers without a session and passes the cloud's `data.connection` through; `credential()` prefers `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` |

## Measurement

Showcase dev boot (`OS_CLOUD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:39871 pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38517`, workspace built at 9ffe8af09) against a throwaway stand-in control plane in the session scratchpad that answers the five cloud endpoints the plugin calls and logs every request it receives. Readings:

- Anonymous: `status` 200 `bound:false`; `bind/start` 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` "Sign in to this environment to connect a cloud account."; `unbind` 401 "Sign in to this environment."
- Admin `bind/start` 200: `user_code`, `interval: 5`, `verification_uri` carrying `runtime_name=vm&runtime_version=0.3.0` (this boot's `/api/v1/discovery` version reads 18.0.0-next.2).
- Cloud-side request log: device code body `client_id objectstack-cli`, `scope openid profile email`; bind body `name vm`, `runtime_version 0.3.0`, `scope`, token; a re-bind adds `runtime_id`; status and revoke carry `Bearer oscc_` (prefix only logged).
- `bind/poll` pending 200 `{pending:true}`; after approval 200 with `runtime_id` and `connection`, and no `runtime_token` in the answer; credential file mode 600 with `runtimeToken`, `runtimeId`, `controlPlaneUrl`, `organizationId`, `accountEmail`, `boundAt`.
- `unbind` (cloud up) `{revoked:true, cleared:true}`; file becomes `{runtimeToken:'', runtimeId}`; status `bound:false` with `runtimeId` kept.
- Cloud stopped while connected: status `bound:true`, `connection:null`; `unbind` `{revoked:false, cleared:true}`.
- A signed-in user without Setup Access (`GET /api/v1/meta/app/setup` 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`) received 200 from `unbind` and from `bind/start`. The page names this as a known defect and links #24148, which the seat filed from this run, together with the anonymous `status` read of the connection.

Both dev servers, the stand-in and the run's `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/` directory were removed after the run.

## Cloud-side statements left unverified

objectstack-ai/cloud is not readable in this session, so the page describes the cloud account only generically ("open the link, sign in to the cloud account, approve the request whose code matches"). Not verified, for the cloud seat:

1. Which cloud accounts may approve a device request for an organization, and with what permissions.
2. Whether, and under what name, the cloud account lists the connected server (the server sends its host name).
3. Whether the cloud account offers its own rename, and whether a re-bind carrying the same `runtime_id` updates the stored name.
4. That a re-bind carrying the stored `runtime_id` reattaches to the same registration (the page says the server sends it "so the cloud can" do so).
5. What `revoke` does cloud-side, and how an operator removes a connection from the cloud account after `revoked: false`.
6. That the cloud serves the organization's own packages to the `oscc_` bearer on the org catalog and manifest routes.
7. The issue's "the same governance": not written on the page, because nothing in the framework determines it.
8. The real `interval` and `expires_in` values (the page states only the server's fallbacks of 5 s and 600 s).

## Patch round 1

The seat widened the file surface (claim amendment `6229839180` on #24066), and the dev made these changes:
- `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write` added the one generated line, `content/docs/deployment/cloud-connection.mdx`, to `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`. `pnpm check:docs-audit-scope` now exits 0.
- `#before-you-start` names the sign-in-only check as a known defect (#24148), with interim advice.
- The `#reference` `status` row no longer lists the approving account's email and organization; it points to #24148.
- `#rename` names the `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` fallback as a known defect (#24150).
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12860 covers the panel's handling of `revoked: false`. `#disconnect` is unchanged.

## Gates

Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 41 commands) and run on the final head a6e913553 (6 paths, 52 commands): all 52 exit 0, `check:docs-audit-scope` included. Round 0 (head 4d2f5c659, 41 commands) had `check:docs-audit-scope` at exit 1, which patch round 1 resolved. `check:skill-examples` first refused with exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no `.d.ts` for spec and client-react), and gave exit 0 after those packages were built. `--ran` reconciliation with exit codes: 52 derived, 52 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24066-cloud-connection-guide`: NOT governed, 239 changed lines.

## Acceptance notes

- `CloudConnectionPluginConfig.credentialPath` is not shared with `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`, which builds `new ConnectionCredentialStore()` at the default path. A host that moves the credential gets an install-local that reads the old location. Nothing in the repo composes `credentialPath`. Carrier: none.
- The plugin's mount log line and file header list the routes without `unbind`. Carrier: none.
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` says `OS_CLI_CLIENT_ID` defaults to nothing and serves `os login`, while the plugin defaults it to `objectstack-cli` for the device flow. `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` is not on that page. Not edited: outside this card's surface. Carrier: none.
- The `examples/app-showcase/objectstack.config.ts` comment "the CLI no longer auto-injects these" contradicts `serve.ts` step 5, which auto-wires them again. Carrier: none.
- `slow_down` is read as pending, but the panel keeps its interval (RFC 8628 says to add 5 s). Not measured against a cloud that sends it. Carrier: none.
